summary: 受光雨滴在两帧实际 GPU 对照中明显减轻固定雨源造成的白色短条和悬浮白屑，保留为可用候选。暗墙与窗面上的雨线仍偏弱，第二帧墙地原有颗粒和拆层背景软化仍在；尚未通过自然降雨、连续动态或整体画质验收。

implementation.source: Existing environment sky and direct sun, with geometry and cloud visibility at each drop fragment.
implementation.environment_approximation: Six fixed world directions; constant incident radiance is preserved exactly by the quadrature.
implementation.compositing: Preserve original coverage, alpha, occlusion and camera-to-drop air prefix. No background-dependent scaling, global exposure change, radiance clamp or added image blur.
implementation.offline_view: Reuse the existing OIDN background only after actual pre-rain HDR equality; recompose with the actual new GPU rain contribution and unchanged coverage. No OIDN rerun.
implementation.display_finding: EV +8 strongly exposes the old fixed rain RGB; WideC1 compresses highlights but is not a hard clip. Display mapping is unchanged.

validation.timing_interpretation: GPU timestamp sum and end-to-end run time are distinct. One pair does not establish a performance gain or real-time throughput.

limits: Dark-background rain remains weak and is particularly difficult to distinguish in the noisy raw render.
Existing frame-1 wall and ground noise, background OIDN softness, sky/cloud detail and scene highlights remain unresolved.
This coarse bounded scattering model omits mesh-emitter illumination and full water refraction; six environment directions can miss narrow lighting features.
The actual configuration has zero live analytic point lights; inactive buffered records were not treated as lights.
Two 640x360 frames do not establish long-motion stability, 1080p quality or complete weather acceptance.

storage_readonly.action: Read-only free-space report; no cleanup or storage-record maintenance.
